_comment: Single source of truth for the /lab/floppy cabinet. Drawers are row-major (top row first). genres match the catalog 'genre' field. 'unsorted' catches anything unmatched. A locked drawer holds products flagged vault:true (sidecar {"vault":true}); passwordHash is sha256(password) — UI gating only, not security. Default password: rmlur  (change it: node -e "crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',new TextEncoder().encode('NEW')).then(b=>console.log(Buffer.from(b).toString('hex')))")
